name: 🔔 Notification System
description: Sistema notifiche configurabile per Heca. V1 implementa notifiche in-app tramite i widget esistenti `Toast`, `ToastStack`, `ToastSpec` e `ToastSeverity`; Heca possiede modello, store, queue, lifecycle, timer, dedup, routing e dispatch azioni. Backend OS/system notifications e integrazione global KeyHint per azioni toast restano differiti. Out of scope: confirmation modals e confirmation-before-action flow.
workDone: Domain model complete and tested (P061 core tasks). Store/lifecycle complete (P056, 9/9). Dismiss actions + notification.pick fully wired (P059, 4/4). notify action registered (P055, T491). Mount as a persistent layer complete (P060, T203). Mid-session: the entire raising API was redesigned at Antonio's direction into a public Notification builder (.info/.body/.action/.send(), no timestamp arg, host-installed sink) — supersedes the notify-action-as-primary-raise-path framing from earlier in the session. NotificationAction gained a variant field crossing the wire as a name.
